description: ZipPrep practice bank. Questions marked verifiedPYQ=false are original practice questions, not certified official previous-year questions.

questions.subject: History
questions.question: Which development is most closely associated with the Neolithic period?
options: Beginning of farming and settled life
questions.explanation: NCERT Class 6 Our Pasts I: farming and herding encouraged settled communities.

questions.subject: History
questions.question: Ashoka's dhamma primarily emphasised:
questions.explanation: NCERT Class 6 Our Pasts I: Ashoka's dhamma promoted respect, non-violence and ethical conduct.

questions.subject: History
questions.question: The Mansabdari system under the Mughals was related to:
questions.explanation: NCERT Class 7 Our Pasts II: mansabs determined rank, status and military responsibilities.

questions.subject: History
questions.question: The Permanent Settlement of Bengal was introduced in 1793 by:
questions.explanation: NCERT Class 8 Our Pasts III: Cornwallis introduced the Permanent Settlement in Bengal.

questions.subject: History
questions.question: The Swadeshi Movement arose in response to:
questions.explanation: NCERT Class 8 Our Pasts III: the anti-partition movement encouraged boycott and swadeshi.

questions.subject: History
questions.question: The Dandi March of 1930 challenged the British:
questions.explanation: NCERT Class 8 Our Pasts III: Gandhi's march protested the colonial salt laws.

questions.subject: Geography
questions.question: The Tropic of Cancer lies at approximately:
questions.explanation: NCERT Class 6 The Earth: Our Habitat: the Tropic of Cancer is at 23½ degrees north.

questions.subject: Geography
questions.question: Most weather phenomena occur in which atmospheric layer?
questions.explanation: NCERT Class 7 Our Environment: weather changes occur in the troposphere.

questions.subject: Geography
questions.question: The Coriolis force is a consequence of:
questions.explanation: NCERT Class 11 Fundamentals of Physical Geography: Earth's rotation deflects moving air and water.

questions.subject: Geography
questions.question: Black soil is particularly suitable for cotton cultivation because it:
questions.explanation: NCERT Class 10 Contemporary India II: black soil has high moisture-retention capacity.

questions.subject: Geography
questions.question: A radial drainage pattern develops when streams flow:
options: Outwards from a central elevated area
At right angles in a rectangular pattern
questions.explanation: NCERT Class 11 Fundamentals of Physical Geography: radial drainage develops around domes and volcanic cones.

questions.subject: Civics & Polity
questions.question: Article 1 of the Indian Constitution describes India as a:
questions.explanation: NCERT Class 11 Indian Constitution at Work: Article 1 describes India as a Union of States.

questions.subject: Civics & Polity
questions.question: Which Fundamental Right abolishes untouchability?
questions.explanation: NCERT Class 8 Social and Political Life III: Article 17 abolishes untouchability.

questions.subject: Civics & Polity
questions.question: Directive Principles of State Policy are:
questions.explanation: NCERT Class 11 Indian Constitution at Work: Article 37 describes the status of DPSPs.

questions.subject: Civics & Polity
questions.question: A Money Bill can be introduced only in the:
questions.explanation: NCERT Class 11 Indian Constitution at Work: Money Bills originate in the Lok Sabha.

questions.subject: Economics
questions.question: GDP measures the value of:
options: Final goods and services produced within domestic territory in a period
questions.explanation: NCERT Class 12 Introductory Macroeconomics: GDP measures final production within domestic territory.

questions.subject: Economics
questions.question: The Public Distribution System mainly aims to:
options: Provide essential food grains at subsidised prices
questions.explanation: NCERT Class 9 Economics: the PDS distributes essential commodities, especially food grains.

questions.subject: Economics
questions.question: A rise in the repo rate generally makes borrowing by commercial banks from the RBI:
questions.explanation: NCERT Class 12 Introductory Macroeconomics: a higher repo rate raises the cost of RBI funds.

questions.subject: Science
questions.question: Which organelle is the main site of photosynthesis?
questions.explanation: NCERT Class 11 Biology: chloroplasts contain chlorophyll and carry out photosynthesis.

questions.subject: Science
questions.question: The SI unit of force is:
questions.explanation: NCERT Class 9 Science: force is measured in newtons.

questions.subject: Science
questions.question: A convex lens forms a virtual, erect and magnified image when the object is:
options: Between the optical centre and focus
questions.explanation: NCERT Class 10 Science: an object within the focal length gives a virtual, erect, magnified image.

questions.subject: Science
questions.question: Which blood component helps in clotting?
questions.explanation: NCERT Class 10 Science: platelets help in blood clotting.

questions.subject: Science
questions.question: The structural and functional unit of the human kidney is the:
questions.explanation: NCERT Class 11 Biology: the nephron is the kidney's functional unit.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The electronic configuration 2,8,1 belongs to:
questions.explanation: NCERT Class 9 Science: sodium has atomic number 11 and configuration 2,8,1.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: A bond formed by sharing electron pairs is called:
questions.explanation: NCERT Class 10 Science and Class 11 Chemistry: covalent bonds involve shared electron pairs.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The slope of a velocity-time graph represents:
questions.explanation: NCERT Class 11 Physics: the slope of a velocity-time graph gives acceleration.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: In a series electric circuit, the current through each resistor is:
questions.explanation: NCERT Class 10 Science: current is the same at every point in a series circuit.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: The HCF of 96 and 404 is:
questions.explanation: NCERT Class 10 Mathematics: Euclid's algorithm gives the HCF as 4.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: The roots of x² − 5x + 6 = 0 have a sum equal to:
questions.explanation: NCERT Class 10 Mathematics: the sum of roots is −b/a, which is 5.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: The probability of obtaining an even number on a fair die is:
questions.explanation: NCERT Class 10 Mathematics: three of six equally likely outcomes are even.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: The derivative of x³ with respect to x is:
questions.explanation: NCERT Class 12 Mathematics: the power rule gives 3x².

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: The hereditary material in most living organisms is:
questions.explanation: NCERT Class 10 Science and Class 12 Biology: DNA carries hereditary information.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: In an ecosystem, the greatest energy is generally available at the level of:
questions.explanation: NCERT Class 10 Science: producers form the first trophic level and contain the most energy.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Choose the correct passive form: 'The committee approved the proposal.'
options: The proposal was approved by the committee.
The proposal is approving the committee.
The committee was approved by the proposal.
questions.explanation: NCERT English grammar: simple past passive uses was/were plus past participle.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to 'meticulous':
questions.explanation: NCERT English vocabulary: meticulous means showing great attention to detail.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Choose the correctly punctuated sentence:
questions.explanation: NCERT English writing conventions: an introductory conjunctive adverb is followed by a comma.

questions.subject: Social Science
questions.question: Which institution conducts elections to Parliament and State Legislatures in India?
questions.explanation: NCERT Class 9 Democratic Politics: the Election Commission supervises these elections.

questions.subject: Social Science
questions.question: In the Indian constitutional context, secularism means that the state:
options: Has no official religion and treats religions impartially
questions.explanation: NCERT Class 8 Social and Political Life and Class 11 Political Theory: Indian secularism rejects an official state religion.

questions.subject: Social Science
questions.question: Which is a tertiary sector activity?
questions.explanation: NCERT Class 10 Understanding Economic Development: banking is a service-sector activity.
